## Problem

Observed behaviour and expected behaviour. Distinguish a reproduced bug from a source-derived hypothesis.

## Environment

Commit, platform/tool versions, build configuration, region/content version and fresh/development/restored player profile.

## Reproduction

1. Starting state
2. Actions
3. Actual result

## Evidence and impact

Sanitised logs, smallest fixture, affected data and repeatability. Do not include private player data or credentials.

## Related work

Planning ID, relevant tests and linked documents. Full template: docs/embervale/08-templates/BUG_REPORT.md.
